# commands-show-output

- ID: `MD014`
- Category: Code
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `code`

Code blocks that show only commands leave out the \$ prompt.

## Why

Commands are easier to copy and paste without the \$. A prompt helps only when
the block also shows output.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix deletes each \$ and the spaces after it. gomdlint may report a finding
without a fix when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets,
such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it
could add or remove a task list checkbox.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `commands-show-output: false` turns the rule off and
`commands-show-output: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable commands-show-output` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line commands-show-output -->
```
